ValidationFailed.description: Validation failed — the input did not parse against the operation schema. Carries `code`: `validation_failed`.

Unauthenticated.description: No session — sign in (or present a bearer token) first. Carries `code`: `unauthenticated`.

Forbidden.description: Refused — the caller lacks the permission this operation checks, or policy forbids it. Carries `code`: `permission_denied` or `forbidden`.

NotFound.description: Unknown operation, or an entity named in the input does not exist. Carries `code`: `not_found`.

Conflict.description: Conflicts with current state — an illegal transition, a name already taken, or a record that is immutable now. Carries `code`: `conflict`.

RateLimited.description: Too many requests for this credential or client address. Wait `Retry-After` seconds, then retry. Carries `code`: `rate_limited`.

RateLimit.description: The budget that refused: `"<bucket>";r=0;t=<seconds until it resets>`.

RateLimit-Policy.description: Every budget the request was counted against: `"<bucket>";q=<limit>;w=<window seconds>`, comma-separated.

InternalError.description: Internal error. The body carries no `detail`, deliberately — an unreviewed message is not disclosed on a multi-tenant surface. Carries `code`: `internal`.

Unavailable.description: The deployment cannot serve this — a required platform facility is unconfigured. Carries `code`: `unavailable`.
